description_en: Modifies the information of a specified bastion host instance
description_zh: 修改指定堡垒机实例的信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-instance-attribute --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gh0000 --description Bastionhost_demo --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID。
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the bastion host instance.

> The description can contain only letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (_), or hyphens (-), and cannot exceed 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的描述信息。

> 只能包含字母、汉字、数字、下划线（_）或短划线（-），长度不能超过30字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host instance.
> For information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id
